scripts:
set properties on /content/dam/ticketingApp/jcr:content
  set cq:conf{String} to /conf/ticketingApp
  set jcr:title{String} to "Ticket Management Application"
end

set ACL for ticketing-developers
  allow jcr:read on /content/ticketingApp
end

set ACL for ticketing-qa
  allow jcr:read on /content/ticketingApp
end

set ACL for anonymous
  deny jcr:read on /content/ticketingApp/tickets
end

set ACL for ticketing-qa
  allow jcr:read,jcr:addChildNodes,jcr:modifyProperties on /content/ticketingApp/tickets
end

set ACL for ticketing-developers
  allow jcr:read,jcr:modifyProperties on /content/ticketingApp/tickets
  deny jcr:addChildNodes on /content/ticketingApp/tickets
end

set ACL for ticketing-user-reader
  allow jcr:read on /home/users
  allow jcr:read on /home/groups
end
